Resolves #19300

Escape now cancels a drag that has crossed into another window. During a converted or cross-window drag the keyboard focus sits in the vessel or the target popup, whose `DragDrop` owns no gesture, so Escape was dropped.

- `DragDrop#onKeyDown`: a window without a gesture of its own sends one `drag:cancel` marked `crossWindow`. It leaves the key's default alone.
- `DomEvent` hands that message to `DragCoordinator#cancelCrossWindowGesture`, together with the message's `windowId`.
- The coordinator asks every other window's new remote `DragDrop#cancelDrag`. Only the gesture's owner holds a `dragZoneId`, so the owner's ordinary cancel runs and every other window does nothing.

The contract (the new remote, the payload, and its per-Escape cost) is the ticket's Contract Ledger.

Evidence: L3 (unit arms red on dev first; a headless probe of the real Workstation cross-window drag at 1920×1080, red without the fix → green with it) → L3 required (AC-4). Residual: none.

size-guard-growth: src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs — +9 code lines: the remote `cancelDrag` through which the App Worker reaches the gesture's owner, plus the cross-window Escape branch; the owner's Escape delegates to `cancelDrag`, so the cancel body exists once.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- |
| AC-1 | `DragDrop.spec` — "Escape in a window without its own gesture asks the App Worker once to cancel a cross-window one". Red on dev. The guard "the gesture owner still cancels its own drag on Escape, once" is green on both. |
| AC-2 | `DragCoordinator.spec` — "a cross-window cancel from one window asks every other window of the app to cancel the drag it owns". It is fired in the shape `worker.Manager#sendMessage` posts, with the `windowId` on the message. Red on dev. |
| AC-3 | `DragDrop.spec` — "cancelDrag cancels the gesture this window owns, once; without one it sends nothing". Red on dev. |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: the headless receipt under Test Evidence. |
| AC-5 | `DockTabSortZone.spec` — "a cancel while the conversion is still pending retires the vessel as a converted one does". A pin of existing behaviour; mutation under Test Evidence. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The routing reads no coordinator state. @neo-gpt's source read showed `activeSourceZone` is null while a conversion is pending, so the ticket's first design (route to the active gesture's source window) would have missed that phase. The ticket body now records the broadcast-to-owner design, the Contract Ledger and AC-5.
- AC-2's arm first carried the `windowId` in `data`. The runtime puts it on the message, so the "skip the window that heard Escape" filter never matched. Firing the runtime shape turned the arm red (all three windows asked). `DomEvent` now passes `event.windowId`.

## Test Evidence

**AC-4.** Journey: large-over-small, "one local proxy plus readable target choices", run headless with #19288's `--screen-info={1920x1080}`. Escape was pressed on the target page while the tab-sized proxy and the target preview were visible, then read after 1.5 s (at `d1e798cabd`; for the red row, the three source files were stashed):

| | pane in main | vessel closed | pane in vessel | proxy in target |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| without the fix | 0 | no | 1 | 1 |
| with the fix | 1 | yes | — | 0 |

The layout Escape restores, from the same journey at `d3a21d327a`:
- **The pane's component chain** (pane → parent → tab container → its parent):
  - Before the drag: `neo-component-15` → `neo-container-10` → `neo-tab-container-4` → `neo-container-21`, in the main window.
  - During the drag: `neo-component-15` → `neo-container-25` → `neo-tab-container-9` → `neo-viewport-3`, in the vessel window.
  - After Escape: identical to before, down to the same tab container instance in the main window.
- **The `workstation-main` dock document:** the source node `right-top-tabs` holds `['audit']`, active `audit`, before the drag, during it and after Escape. No node differs between before and after. The document did not change during the drag either, so this shows the cancel committed nothing; the chain is what moved and came back.
- **The limit:** this journey's source node holds one tab, so its order is kept trivially. Restoring a multi-tab source is the existing cancel path, which #19301 reaches but does not change.

<details><summary>The probe (temporary, not committed)</summary>

`probeMainDoc()` is read once before `beginActualTearOut`, once before Escape, and once 1.5 s after it. It reads `getWorkspaceDocument('workstation-main')` (the node holding `cell.itemId`) and walks `app.getComponent(id, ['parentId', 'windowId'])` up four hops from `getPaneIdentity(cell.itemId)`. Escape is pressed with `targetPage.keyboard.press('Escape')`, placed right after the "target preview remains visible beside proxy" expectation. The run appends `--screen-info={1920x1080}` to `launchArgs` in `playwright.config.e2e.mjs`.
</details>

**AC-5 mutation.** Removing `transitioning` from `TabSortZone#onDragCancel`'s conversion test turns the arm red. It is green again with the source restored.
